RegistrationInfo.Description: W365 thin client YOLO v2 (SCRIPT-FREE, Oct 13 2026): ONE task, FOUR event triggers plus an idle trigger, all firing rwinsta.exe console as LOCAL SYSTEM (S-1-5-18). Triggers: Power-Troubleshooter 1 (wake), Kernel-Power 107 (Sx resume), Kernel-Power 507 exit with Reason Lid(15)/Power Button(1)/Battery Drain Budget Exceeded(55) and NO duration floor, ClientActiveXCore 1026 (RDP disconnected, Operational log). The IdleTrigger logs off after 60 minutes without input - its duration is carried in Settings/IdleSettings (Duration PT1H, WaitTimeout PT1H; StopOnIdleEnd stays false). HISTORY: the original six-trigger build added two Analytic-channel triggers (1019 unfiltered; 1003 filtered to disconnect-reason Value 4616) and a BUILTIN Users InteractiveToken principal; Task Scheduler rejected registration with 'The request is not supported' on Oct 13, 2026 - consistent with event subscriptions being unsupported on Analytic channels. The Analytic triggers were removed and the principal reverted to LOCAL SYSTEM at Bruce's direction. Separately, the power-button pilot exposed a UI-introduced idle condition (StopOnIdleEnd) that terminated instances at wake with result 0x41306 ('terminated by the user'); the pin is serialized inside Settings/IdleSettings exactly as a native Windows export does (an earlier build wrongly placed it in a top-level Conditions element - no such element exists in the task XML schema - and broke import; corrected against Bruce's native export, Oct 13 2026). Probe: import W365-LogoffOnAnalytic1019-TEST.xml standalone; if it throws the same error, the Analytic channel is convicted.

EventTrigger.Subscription: <QueryList><Query Id="0" Path="System"><Select Path="System">*[System[Provider[@Name='Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-Power'] and (EventID=507)] and EventData[(Data[@Name='Reason']=15 or Data[@Name='Reason']=1 or Data[@Name='Reason']=55)]]</Select></Query></QueryList>
